changelog: One-click updates: with a valid license, click “Update now” on the Plugins screen. Each download is checked against a published checksum before it’s installed
一鍵更新：授權有效時，在外掛頁按「立即更新」即可；每次下載都會先比對公布的檢查碼才安裝
From this version on you won’t need to download and upload zips by hand / 從這一版起不必再手動下載上傳 zip
